## About this property

### BEAUTIFUL VILLA WITH PRIVATE POOL, GARDEN NEAR THE BEACH, HEATED POOL

Beautiful villa in a prime location, right on the beach in between Las Chapas and Los Monteros, Marbella. It has 4 comfortable bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, large living room with American kitchen, fully equipped kitchen with all necessary utensils, garden, terrace and parking nearby, restaurants, supermarket, etc. This is a residential beach. It is an ideal place for a relaxing beach vacation yet close to all local amenities. Ideal for families, groups or golfers as the area is full of golf courses! Parking, barbecue area, swimming pool with salt water (no chemicals). ADSL Wi-Fi Internet, UK TV, German television, DVD (3d blu-ray, USB host). Close to restaurants and a supermarket. The rent includes cleaning before arrival and on departure, electricity, linen and towels (including beach towels), Internet WiFi, garden supplies and local taxes. 500 € - returnable damage deposit. HEATED POOL ON REQUEST DURING WINTER MONTHS! There is an additional fee for the heated pool. The cost is € 30 per day, the minimum fee is € 120.

Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

## About the neighborhood

### Marbella

Located on the beach, this villa is in Urbanización Costabella, a neighborhood in Marbella. Marbella Marina and Puerto Banús Marina are worth checking out if an activity is on the agenda, while those wishing to experience the area's natural beauty can explore Malaga Province Beaches and Nikki Beach. Traveling with kids? Consider El Pinillo Beach, or check out an event or a game at Don Carlos Tennis & Sports Club. Fishing offers a great chance to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with hiking nearby.
